notes: Basket Protocol index vault for Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). BaskVault is the Basket (BASK) ERC-20 share: 18 decimals, zero supply at deployment, no supply cap; deposits mint and redemptions burn. The constructor takes the explicit owner and guardian literals in that order, rejects zero or equal addresses, and makes no external calls. STOCK_FACTORY is the source constant 0x4783C67b63dE2B358Ac5951a7D41F47A38F3C046. All views are in BaskVault; BaskMath functions are internal and require no separate deployment. Assets start empty, are append-only and limited to 64. Before deposits, the owner directly lists at least three verified token/feed pairs and calls finalizeGenesis once; the opening delay is 72 hours. These are later owner operations, not launch initialization calls. Deposits require the weekday 15:30-19:30 UTC gate, three unretired feeds updated within four hours, valid banded prices no more than 26 hours old, healthy balances, and exact incoming transfers. NAV uses managed balances only; direct donations are excluded. NAV_CAP starts at USD 1,000,000 and cannot exceed USD 10,000,000,000; asset concentration, 30-day probation for later listings, and the decaying global deposit bucket also limit deposits. Deposit and redemption fees are fixed at 50 basis points, rounded up. FeeRecipient starts unset and the owner may set it once to a nonzero address other than the vault; it is never called. Until set, deposit fee shares are not minted and redemption fee shares are burned. The first deposit locks 1e15 shares at address(0xdEaD). Ownership transfers in two steps with no renounce. The owner proposes listings, feed changes, band changes, reopening, retirement, guardian replacement and NAV-cap increases; anyone may execute after seven days and before fourteen days. Listing and feed replacement share a 24-hour execution cooldown. Both roles may pause deposits, close assets and cancel proposals, except the guardian cannot cancel guardian replacement. Only the owner may unpause or immediately lower NAV_CAP. Later closes cancel earlier reopening proposals; cap reductions cancel pending raises. Redemption reads no prices and ignores deposit pauses, market gates, asset closure and retirement. Each asset balance read has a 50,000-gas allowance; unreadable balances fall back to managed amounts. Payments use self-only calls capped at 250,000 gas, with exact outgoing balance checks; failed legs become owed claims. A claimant may choose a receiving address, and claim payments have no fixed gas cap. Anyone may flag a larger deficit and recognize the smaller of recorded and current shortfall after seven days; successful deposits clear unretired deficit records. No role can block redeem or claim, mint outside deposit, change fees, upgrade, rescue or sweep. Accepted design risks: deposit-then-redeem can profit when a feed lags more than the 1% round-trip fee; the owner must pair each Stock Token with its true feed; an untransferable asset retains its feed value until deposits are paused; a retired asset contributes zero NAV while remaining in the redemption basket.
